articles.title: US Tightens Rules for Diplomats' Airport Use in Saudi Arabia Amid Strikes - State Dept.
articles.description: MOSCOW (Sputnik) - The State Department has required US diplomats working in Saudi Arabia to coordinate the use of three of the country's airports amid strikes by Yemen's Ansar Allah movement, also known as the Houthis.
